messages:
matt: Heads-up — PR #7012 (adaptive-scheduler) is ready for merge but CI perf job flagged a tail-latency regression on long-seq workloads. Pinned the canary; holding merge until we triage. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7012 

ci-bot: perf-run/longseq (commit 9f3b2c) finished. Summary attached.

matt: attaching the quick summary from the bench run:

```
benchmark: longseq-throughput-16
baseline (main): p50=44.8ms p95=120.4ms p99=210.2ms mem/worker=2.1GB
PR #7012:          p50=45.5ms p95=128.6ms p99=224.9ms mem/worker=2.5GB
delta: p95 +6.8% (+8.2ms), p99 +7.1%, mem +400MB
notes: regression concentrated at sequence lengths > 8k, single-node GPU A100-80GB, batch scheduler config = adaptive (new)
```

ana: thanks for the summary. do we have flamegraphs or heap dumps? the mem jump is concerning. could be KV cache retention change.

raj: i skimmed the code in the scheduler change — there is a new keepalive for microbatches that could increase lifetime of some buffers. i'll run a focused mem prof on the canary in staging.

lucy: pinging @matt — can you confirm if this PR changes the eviction thresholds or just scheduling window?

matt: it only adjusts the scheduling window and how we coalesce microbatches; eviction logic untouched. but coalescing keeps activations around slightly longer which may explain mem.

tim: quick thought — try running the bench with ADAPTIVE_BATCH_CAP=8 (vs default 16) to see if coalesce size is the culprit. also add --kv-ttl=30s to test earlier eviction.

raj: started a re-run with ADAPTIVE_BATCH_CAP=8 and kv-ttl=30s, job id perf-2163459-retry. preliminary numbers look better for p95, memory drops ~150MB. will post full results when done.

ana: if the smaller cap removes the regression, that suggests we need an explicit cap or gated rollout for the scheduler change. we should not merge until we have a mitigation (config or fix).

matt: agree. i'll mark the PR as "hold - perf" and add a canary rollout plan: gate adaptive-scheduler behind feature flag and default to old scheduler for Dedicated customers.

ci-bot: job perf-2163459-retry finished: p50=45.0ms p95=122.0ms p99=214.0ms mem/worker=2.35GB (with ADAPTIVE_BATCH_CAP=8, kv-ttl=30s). delta vs main: p95 +1.3%, mem +250MB.

lucy: thanks @raj and @tim for quick runs. 1.3% p95 is tolerable but mem +250MB still needs root cause. i'd prefer an immediate config gate + follow-up bug to optimize buffer lifetimes.

matt: plan: 1) add feature flag + default to old scheduler, 2) open follow-up perf issue with heap profiles, 3) keep PR blocked until feature flag landed (can be separate tiny PR). i'll update the PR description with the mitigation steps.

ana: OK. tagging @eng-oncall to keep an eye on canary dashboards during the gated rollout. :thumbsup:

raj: filing the mem profile issue now and attaching the profiling artifacts from staging. issue #914.

matt: thanks all — i'll update PR and ping for approvals once flag PR is in.

lucy: quick nudge — if anyone has a spare minute, please add an approval on the flag PR (small change) so we can move fast after a follow-up fix.

matt: noted. will hold merge until approvals + flag in. :ok_hand:
